summary: Platinum Group Metals filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release, equivalent to a US Form 8-K furnished disclosure, detailing its majority-owned subsidiary Lion Battery Technologies' technical progress rather than a transactional event. Independent testing by the Battery Innovation Center in Newberry, Indiana validated platinum- and palladium-catalysed lithium-sulfur pouch-cell prototypes, with palladium-rich formulations strongest. Platinum Group and Valterra Platinum approved funding for the next pilot-scale stage targeting drones. No securities, ownership stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, votes, or regulatory clocks are involved; eight US patents granted to date. Watch for commercialisation milestones.
